hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom AMM hook that implements a bespoke liquidity curve backed by Euler Finance lending vaults. In beforeSwap, it computes quotes via its own curve, takes input tokens, deposits them into the LP's Euler vault, withdraws output from the counterpart vault, and settles with the PoolManager — replacing standard pool liquidity with yield-bearing vault positions. beforeAddLiquidity and beforeDonate both revert to prevent standard LP usage.
